title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Powerboat Gatefold. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Powerboat Gatefold
options.thesis: The library is a magazine spread: one HydroStep hull at gatefold scale, the rest of the fleet as a searchable contents strip.
options.viewport: A landscape printed spread: one HydroStep boat fills the page; the model name sits in a fixed plate; a searchable contents strip of the handful of hulls runs the foot.
options.risk: Reads as a generic boating-magazine website if the search is a site search bar and the hull is stock photography.

raised.raise: The spread owns the whole viewport as one continuous printed sheet.
Model name occupies a fixed engineered plate, not a caption under the photo.
The hull is shown at object scale with a boxed 1:1 call-out for the model name.
Color lives in the stock and rules; the photograph stays photographic.
The stock is one ink at full strength, not polite catalog white.

options.label: Workshop Polaroid Wall
options.lineage: yard launch photos pinned to a workshop wall
options.thesis: The library is a wall of launch photos; each HydroStep boat is a print with the model name on the border, and a finder works the wall.
options.viewport: A cork wall of a handful of HydroStep Polaroids; one print sits large; search shuffles which prints come forward.
options.risk: Also the direction most boat-catalog runs land on: a photo grid with labels.

options.label: Leather Reading Shelf
options.thesis: Each HydroStep boat is a handled object on a shelf: pull it to see the photo and the model name.
options.viewport: A walnut shelf of a handful of boat dossiers; the pulled object opens to a photo and a tooled model name.
options.case: Holds clarity for a handful of hulls you can pick up; loses identification — saddle leather is not the fast-boat world’s material.
options.risk: Reads as a bookshop, not a performance-boat library, if the leather is the subject.

options.label: One-bit Desktop
options.thesis: HydroStep boats become windows and icons on a dithered desktop you rummage.
options.viewport: Overlapping named windows; each boat is a dithered icon that opens into a window.
options.case: Fuses poorly: one-bit dither destroys the photograph the visitor must recall.
options.kept: Total environmental commitment — the spread is one printed sheet.
options.risk: The photo, which is the proof, cannot survive two-color dither.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: The fleet is a bank of glowing tubes; model names occupy fixed decimal places.
options.viewport: Tube banks as the only interface; each boat is a glowing model string.
options.case: Loses both axes: lab counters are not the fast-boat world, and quantities are not photographs.
options.kept: Fixed-place engineered display for the model name.
options.risk: A counter cannot carry a hull photograph.

options.label: Brick Build Instructions
options.thesis: Each HydroStep boat is a numbered step with a 1:1 photo call-out.
options.viewport: A sky-blue spread: oversized step numeral, hull at 1:1, model name in a cornered call-out box.
options.case: Loses identification (toy instructions) and mis-states the job (existing boats, not assembly).
options.kept: 1:1 object-scale call-out of the hull and model name.
options.risk: Teaches building when the job is looking through boats that already exist.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: The fleet sits in a quiet white field; color only crowns the active boat’s edge.
options.viewport: A pale field of boat photos; the selected hull wears a narrow spectral edge.
options.case: Loses both axes: meteorology is not this audience, and a pastel fringe does not identify a hull.
options.kept: Color confined to stock and rules; the photograph stays photographic.
options.risk: The library becomes weather, not boats.

options.label: Single-hue Brand Program
options.thesis: One HydroStep ink floods ground, type, and frame; the boat photo is the only other object.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge committed ink; one hull in the frame; model name in white reverse.
options.case: Loses identification (toy-box program) and can drown the photograph the visitor must recall.
options.kept: One ink at full strength as the stock, not polite catalog white.
options.risk: The hue becomes the subject instead of the HydroStep hull.

canonCard.label: Brokerage catalog grid
canonCard.thesis: What boat-listing sites ship: a clean card grid of hulls, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A filterable grid of HydroStep boats; each card is photo, model name, and owner.
